ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters; estimated ratio of 93% low-intensity to 7% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous patches localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; sparse distribution of high-intensity focal speckles (circular clusters < 10 pixels in diameter) across the medial ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing boundary; irregular peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranging from 5 to 30 pixels; jagged contour clearly isolated from the background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve along the trailing edge leading to acute, dorsally-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: White pixel clusters at the distal tips; one distinct circular high-contrast spot on the upper mid-section of the left lobe lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical white linear disruption approx. 40 pixels in length on the outer third of the right lobe; faint horizontal linear marks visible near the medial-right region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography; distinct white linear scar on right lobe; brownish-red biological protrusions at both distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Brownish-red non-pigment appendages (potential cyamid clusters or barnacle remnants) at the furthest lateral points of both fluke lobes.
